title: Crazy bulks: secret for INSANE gains?
summary: NH asks whether dirty bulking is the hidden reason many big naturals got big. He argues the body only uses a limited share of surplus calories for muscle, so huge surpluses add fat and illusory size and strength, and the people who got big did so in spite of dirty bulking. He uses his own bulk to 240 lb as a cautionary tale and recommends a slow, conservative surplus.
claims: Eating more does make you gain more; a surplus guarantees muscle building while maintenance or deficit makes it uncertain
Anabolic only means the body has resources to build; in a surplus it builds both muscle and fat, not only muscle
Muscle building is low on the body's priority list behind keeping organs running, so only a fraction of extra calories goes to muscle
Calories the body doesn't use for muscle are stored as fat; it cannot simply discard them
Muscle does not turn into fat when you stop training; muscle atrophies while people keep eating the same and get fat
Omar Isuf and Alpha Destiny are examples of YouTubers who dirty bulked and came out big after cutting
The muscle gain difference between a slow bulk and a dirty bulk is negligibly small, if it exists at all
You cannot force the body to build more muscle by feeding it more; food doesn't work like steroids, which do scale with dose
People keep dirty bulking because they get bigger, but the size is fat; body dysmorphia makes them count it as progress
NH dirty bulked to 240 lb and was borderline obese while his body dysmorphia told him it was working
Gaining bodyweight raises strength through better leverages, especially on bench and overhead press, without much added muscle
Put 50 lb on your frame and you can add about 100 lb to your bench
NH benched 335 lb when bulked up because he was fat, and regressed when the fat came off
Even for powerlifting, a fluffy lifter loses to lighter lifters in his weight class who got strong without stuffing their face
The size and strength gained from dirty bulking are illusions; whatever is kept would have come from any surplus
A 4% calorie increase over time always beats a 40% increase because the body can only use so much
The goal is to have as much of the surplus as possible go to muscle; gaining more fat than muscle on a bulk is a problem
After a dirty bulk you must cut in a deficit and lose the strength and size you thought you'd gained
NH went from 240 to 210 lb when he cut, losing about 30 lb of fat
Everyone who cuts finds they carry much more fat than they thought and must go far lower in weight to get lean
A reasonable body fat range for naturals is about 12-16%, maybe up to 18%; dirty bulkers go into the 20s
The fatter you get, the less anabolic you become because testosterone drops
Dirty bulkers are impatient, so they suicide cut and lose muscle, entering a yo-yo 'diet purgatory' and staying the same for 10 years
Extra bodyweight from dirty bulking puts more load on the tendons and hurts mental health
An inch gained on the arms in three months is fat, not muscle
Science suggests you gain less muscle when stuffing your face and getting higher body fat
People who got big off dirty bulks got big in spite of them; NH's best gains came on a very slow bulk
NH's dirty bulk left lasting love handles that still gain fat easily
Impatience forces patience later, because mistakes have to be undone with time off or recovery windows
Muscle gain is slow and fat gain is fast, so don't trade one for the other
Losing dirty-bulk fat through a recomp is about 15 times slower than a slow bulk; NH is going through one now
Some fat gain is inevitable when bulking; aim to minimize fat and maximize muscle
